notes: Synthetic object (0x240 bytes) and four grid rows: object lookup present or absent, inactive flag, cell reset state 0/1/2, owner word equal to the marker, 0xff, the marker plus 0x100 or random, movement modes 0, 12 and others, player unit equal or not (including a high-word mismatch), grid mode 0/1/2, panel source absent or with words 1, 0, 2, -1, 0x101, and shown states 0/1/2. Callees are loggers (word inputs masked) returning a shared queue whose first entry is the object.
